author: mwongj
release_notes: Release candidate for missing-only Dispatcharr enrichment before filtering and generation. Enrich missing enabled year/score/genre fields before metadata and title rejection; add independent movie genre rules. Durable provider-response evidence, paced requests, transactional native replay and verification protect output on failed or unresolved enrichment. Populate missing selected series episode lists before workers while retaining batching and stable managed filenames. Supervise catalogue snapshots; previews/snapshots may update native metadata and incidental episodes without deleting output. Preserve all 1.20.3 packaging and NFO archival fixes, including enrichment failure protection for NFO-only archives. Successful evidence has no TTL and does not automatically detect later provider episode additions. Minimum/current pinned helper compatibility and the combined regression suite verified.
